{{Quote|And then the Great Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, bravely standing alone against the First Order...|translated=1|Oniho Zaya retelling the Battle of Crait|<ref name="Adaptation 6">[[The Last Jedi Adaptation 6|''The Last Jedi Adaptation'' 6]]</ref>}}
'''Oniho Zaya''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Youngling|child]] who worked as one of [[Bargwill Tomder]]'s stable hands at the [[fathier]] stables in [[Canto Bight]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> During the [[First Order-Resistance War]], he regaled his fellow urchins<ref name="Episode VIII" /> [[Temiri Blagg]] and [[Arashell Sar]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> with a story<ref name="Episode VIII" /> in [[Cantonican]]<ref name="Language">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}}</ref> about [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and how he stood alone against the [[First Order military|forces]] of the [[First Order]] at the [[Battle of Crait]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Oniho Zaya first appeared in the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], the second film in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]] directed by [[Rian Johnson]], and was portrayed by [[Josiah Oniha]]; the character's name is based on the actor's name. The actor was credited as "Stable Kid" in the film's credits.<ref name="Episode VIII" />
